How can proletarians be free, when great capitalists, despite their minority, manage with the power of their wealth to influence public opinion and governments and ultimately impose their desires? How can survivors of their labour income be considered free when, in the free market for products, large incomes of the rich compete with their own small incomes? How can all people be considered free and equal when they start life on unequal social and economic conditions?"
